title: Map and inspect Automobile Download and Upload results
steps: In GIS, open the Automobile layer configuration and choose Download or Upload under Test type.
Add the selected layer to show matching test results as map points.
Select a result point to open its details. Use the chart to compare signal strength with the Download Rate or Upload Rate over time, and review the test details table below.
Sort the table by a supported column heading or filter a supported column to find matching rows.
If a result has zero duration, its details are unavailable. If analysis is loading or reports an error, wait for it to finish or select Retry when offered.
screenshotCaptions: The selected Download result shows its summary details.
The Upload result chart plots signal strength in dBm and Upload Rate in Mbps over time.
The Download test-results table shows its columns across the horizontal scroll states.
The Upload details table is sorted by rate in ascending order.
The applied table filter leaves matching result rows visible.
The zero-duration result does not open a details dialog.
The selected result shows an analysis error without the previous result details.
reason: Adds instructions for choosing Automobile Download or Upload results, viewing their charts and tables, exploring table rows, and understanding unavailable or loading analyses.
